blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Empowering the newly reorganized Judicial Integrity Office (JIO) to be able to conduct mandatory lifestyle checks, as well as calling for the deployment of specialized cyber threat units under the Office of the Judiciary Marshals (OJM) to safeguard the judiciary is among the priorities of Supreme Court Associate Justice Jose Midas Marquez if ever appointed chief justice. During his interview with the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC), Marquez outlined key anti-corruption and cybersecurity measures under his proposed Strategic Plan for Judicial Innovations 2.0 (SPJI 2.0 2028–2032).
